I appreciate that an intelligent person who has a great vocabulary in their native language may feel frustrated when they struggle to say something in their second language. I also know how fabulous it feels to overcome those challenges. I understand what my students need because I am a student.

However, I strongly believe in taking notes and collaborating on corrections. I always make these notes and summaries available after each session.

I am teaching the conversation for non-Arabic speakers from all over the world on the Internet on several sites and centers.
Speaking: Acquired vocabulary and grammar skills are useless if the language learner cannot verbally produce fluent language. For this reason, my courses emphasized the development of oral fluency above all other key language skills. Through a communicative and student centered approach, our instructors give students as many opportunities to practice speech as possible. my content-based learning immersion activities (like cooking club and calligraphy) give students even more contact time with the Arabic language.

Listening: The primary objective of our Arabic instructors as they speak in class is to model native speech and pronounciation. In practice an immersion curriculum does not rely heavily on grammar drills or assignments in translation. At the beginning level of our Arabic classes, i spoke as little English as possible (less than 5%). From the intermediate level onward English will not be spoken at all.

Reading/Writing: Another key skill area, literacy. In order to foster development in reading and writing in Arabic, our instructors insure that the content they are using has connection to students' interests and that it resonates with them. Many times the difference between success and failure in a classroom is engagement. At Qalam wa Lawh we strive to ensure that all of the material in our classrooms is worth reading.

Presentational Skills: Presenting information clearly and effectively is another vital communication skill. Today, presentational skills are required in almost every field. For this reason, all students at Qalam wa Lawh are prepared for and expected to present in Arabic for 5 minutes and participate in a short Q&A with their peers at the completion of their course.

Super Conversation English Classes

Our Super Conversation English Classes are designed to help you master the English language in a dynamic and supportive environment. These classes are more than just lessons; they’re opportunities to engage in meaningful conversations that enhance your fluency, sharpen your grammar, and fine-tune your pronunciation.

Each session is crafted to meet your individual learning goals, with activities that challenge you to think critically, solve problems, and express yourself with clarity. Whether you’re a beginner or advancing toward fluency, we’ve got a class structure that adapts to your level and learning pace.

Course Description:
Our Business English Classes are tailored to professionals looking to enhance their English language skills in a business context. The course covers essential topics such as business communication, presentations, negotiations, and writing professional emails. With practical exercises and real-world scenarios, you will improve your fluency and accuracy, making you more effective and confident in the workplace. Enroll now to advance your career with strong Business English skills.
Interview Classes:
This interview class focuses on preparing you for job interviews by practicing common questions, improving your answers, and building confidence. You will learn useful vocabulary, body language tips, and strategies to make a great impression during any interview.

IELTS Preparation Course

Our IELTS Preparation Course is designed to help you achieve your best possible score on the IELTS exam. This course focuses on all four language skills: listening, reading, writing, and speaking. Through interactive lessons, practice tests, and personalized feedback, you will develop the strategies and skills needed to excel in each section of the exam. Join us to gain the confidence and competence to succeed in your IELTS test.

pro_course_detail.title: General English for beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
Hey there! Are you ready to take your English to the next level? In this beginner's course, we'll kick things off by covering all the basics.

We'll start with the essentials - reading, writing, grammar, and speaking - but don't worry, we'll make it super fun and interactive! Think of it like a game where you'll level up your English skills with each lesson.

We'll have plenty of engaging exercises, topics to chat about, and even create our own little conversations. You'll also get to share your thoughts and ideas with others while improving your conversational skills.

To spice things up, we'll watch some awesome short videos and talk about real-life situations. This way, you'll be able to understand English in context and apply it in your daily life.

No boring textbooks, no mind-numbing lectures - just exciting, fun, and practical learning!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Boostcamp
pro_course_detail.description:

But don't worry if technology isn't your thing - we'll have plenty of other worlds to explore as well! From the bustling streets of New York City to the serene countryside of France, there's something for everyone in our immersive experience.

Along the way, you'll encounter interesting characters and fascinating stories that will help you develop your English skills in a natural and enjoyable way. 

Our interactive games and activities will challenge you to think on your feet, communicate effectively, and have fun while doing it.

pro_course_detail.description:

a) This course is suitable for students with some prior knowledge of English (B1 + ).
b) I only accept students over the age of 18.
c) This course does not follow a curriculum. 
d) Lessons will be fully charged if not cancelled or rescheduled with at least 24 hours' notice. 
    
The aim of this course is to address your English language needs and to teach you in a way that suits you.  At the end of the session, you will always have some notes that include new items of vocabulary, pronunciation points and a section which shows you how to make your English sound more natural.

pro_course_detail.title: Job Interviews
pro_course_detail.description: In these sessions we will go through some of the very typical questions interviewers ask applicants at interview.  The focus is on accurate and clear production of the language. Having taught a number of professionals working in human resources, I can also provide you with some tips as to how to answer those trickier questions such as: ‘What can you bring to the company?’ or ‘Where do you see yourself in five years’ time?’

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation
pro_course_detail.description: In these lessons, the focus is on enhancing your speaking and writing skills. With regard to speaking, in the lessons we will run through some IELTS mock interviews paying particular attention to improving your fluency, lexical range, grammar and pronunciation.  As for writing, I will set one IELTS writing task per 60-minute lesson for homework and correct it outside lesson time.  In the following lesson, we will discuss ways of improving your written work according to the IELTS assessment criteria.

pro_course_detail.title: CAE Preparation
pro_course_detail.description: In these lessons, the focus is on honing your speaking and writing skills. With regard to speaking, in the lessons we will practise doing mock Cambridge C1 interviews, working particularly on enhancing your ability to express complex ideas using a wide range of grammatical structures and vocabulary items.  As for writing, I will set one Cambridge C1 writing task per 60-minute lesson for homework and correct it outside lesson time.  In the following lesson, we will discuss ways of improving your written work according to the Cambridge C1 assessment criteria.

pro_course_detail.title: Improve your Language Skills at Work
